headline: One picture, 2 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 2 different works in 1 village. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 0 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.006 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 77cc94ca3987 on 1 work, b4868007c6f1 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Recharge Pit (2).
All 2 works report the same GPS point (25.262174, 82.739868).
The picture was uploaded 2 times within 19 minutes (2025-10-04 10:28:25 to 2025-10-04 10:47:19).
